name: Phase Oscillator
author: Eric Gao
description: Casio CZ-style phase distortion built as a chain: the phase ramp passes through two operators in series, each crossfaded continuously across a bank of four. Composition is not commutative, which is the point.

controls.label: Drive
controls.description: Scans the second operator bank: identity, square, warp, double warp. Smooth curves, applied after the shape.

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Scans the first operator bank: identity, saw knee, pulse plateau, fold. Corners, and the CZ character.

controls.label: Depth
controls.description: Depth of the whole chain. Fully down passes the ramp through untouched, leaving a plain sine.

controls.label: Octave
controls.description: Blends MAIN from the fundamental reader up to the doubled one, an octave above on the same waveform.

outputs.main: Fundamental reader blended toward the doubled reader by Octave
outputs.aux: The doubled reader alone, an octave up on the same waveform
